d.s: SikaRoof VersiScape Reinforcement is a square hollow section reinforcement bar used to increase flexural strength of raised flooring safety panels. The reinforcement bars are manufactured from aluminium and are used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiScape Panel. The reinforcement bars are inserted on the under surface and long the four sides of the panel.
a: Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
us: Reinforcement bar for safety panel for raised flooring for podiums, balconies and roof terraces. The safety panel may be used to raise conventional 600 x 600 mm pavers, pavers of varying sizes, artificial grass, or a combination of the three.

sec.t: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet.
Product must be stored in their original packing, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.
